# @ratmath/structures

> Abstract algebra for RatMath: finite groups, exact polynomials in several variables, Gröbner bases, ideals, quotient rings, polynomial systems solved exactly, the integers mod n and quadratic integer rings, presentations, abelian groups and modules over Q[x]. Part of the RatMath Shelf; numbers come from @ratmath/core (a peer dependency). ESM: `import * as structures from "@ratmath/structures"`.

Built from 0.5.0, commit de6732b plus uncommitted changes. `file:line` is relative to the package root (also node_modules/@ratmath/structures/); on GitHub: https://github.com/ratmath/structures/blob/de6732b/<file>#L<line>. Docs pages are under https://ratmath.com/structures/. Full types: index.d.ts.

Types: `type Exponents = number[] | Record<string, number>`; `type MonomialOrder = "lex" | "grlex" | "grevlex" | ((a: number[], b: number[]) => number)`; `type PolyLike<C = Rational> = MPoly<C> | string | number | bigint | Rational | C`; `type FractionLike<C = Rational> = RationalFunction<C> | PolyLike<C>`; `type PermutationLike = number[] | string`; `type Perm = number[]`; `type Matrix = number[][]`; `type ElementLike<E> = E | string | { index: number }`; `type PowerPair = [number, 0 | 1]`; `type HomSpec<A, B> = ((x: A) => B) | Array<ElementLike<B>> | Map<ElementLike<A>, ElementLike<B>>`; `type Word = number[]`; `type WordLike = Word | string`; `type HomologyCoefficients = "Z" | "Q" | `Z/${number}` | number | bigint`; `type IntLike = number | bigint`; `type QuadLike = QuadraticInteger | IntLike`; `type PermLike = number[] | string`; `type TowerLike = TowerElement | Rational | number | bigint | string | MPoly`; `type UnivariateLike = string | MPoly | Array<number | bigint | string | Rational | [bigint | number, bigint | number]>`

## Docs

- https://ratmath.com/structures/llms-full.txt: every page below as Markdown, each with a runnable example
- Pages: index (Overview), reference (Reference), explore (Explore), groups (Groups and how to build them), classes (Conjugacy classes and commutators), subgroups (Subgroups and quotients), sylow (Sylow subgroups), homomorphisms (Homomorphisms and isomorphism), actions (Actions and counting), presentations (Presentations and coset enumeration), characters (Character tables), class-functions (Working with characters), large-groups (Large permutation groups), abelian (Abelian groups), modules (Modules over Q[x]), homology (Chain complexes and homology), polynomials (Polynomials in several variables), orders (Monomial orders and division), gcd (Greatest common divisors), factoring (Factoring), resultants (Resultants and discriminants), rational-functions (Rational functions), groebner (Gröbner bases), ideals (Ideals), systems (Solving polynomial systems), quotients (Quotient rings), modular (The integers mod n), quadratic (Quadratic integer rings), towers (Field extensions and towers), galois (Automorphisms and the Galois correspondence), radicals (Solving by radicals), constructions (Ruler and compass), conway (Conway polynomials), symmetric (Symmetric polynomials)

## Example

```js
import { ring, gcd, resultant, factor, fractions, symmetric } from "@ratmath/structures";
const S = symmetric(4);
console.log(S.describe());
console.log("class equation:", S.classEquation(), "  Sylow counts:", [2, 3].map((p) => S.sylowCount(p)));

const R = ring("x, y, z");
const f = R.poly("x^3 + y^3 + z^3 - 3xyz");
console.log("f =", f);
for (const { factor: g, multiplicity } of factor(f).factors) console.log("  factor:", g, "to the power", multiplicity);
console.log("gcd:", gcd(R.poly("x^3 - y^3"), R.poly("x^2 - y^2")));
console.log("circle and parabola meet where", resultant(R.poly("x^2 + y^2 - 1"), R.poly("y - x^2"), "y"), "= 0");
fractions(R).parse("1/(x + y) + 1/(x - y)")
```
